resolvedFinding.cause: Zero-attempt windows erased sparse successful recovery evidence, leaving 0/5% output indefinitely low.
resolvedFinding.repair: Empty windows add no healthy duration and mark current evidence/service unknown. Previous real clean evidence can survive gaps for at most three seconds. Invalid/error/epoch/time-reset evidence clears it. At most one bounded ordinary probe per monotonic second and only when an actual complete frame is offered avoids a zero-output absorbing state. A probe is a selection counter, never completion evidence.
